selections.rationale: Main-approved. Exactly one bounded test-only correction from R19; preserve specification, reference and known-bad bytes unchanged. Preserve all valid existing R19 tests. Add ordinary unhashable invalid kinds [] and {} with otherwise valid reply fields; each must raise ValueError, not TypeError. Retain None and integer 1 invalid-kind ValueError controls and malformed-field TypeError controls. Add a valid MappingProxyType reply mapping with id and exactly boolean accepted; require correct kind, fields and is_consistent, then mutate its backing dictionary and a returned fields dictionary and verify the stored reply remains unchanged. Do not require the returned mapping to preserve its wrapper class. Retain MappingProxy job with nested mutable tags, UserDict and ordinary dict controls, constructor and fresh-property deep-copy isolation, exact key schemas, ID/tag nonemptiness, priority 0..9 with bool excluded and exact boolean accepted. Do not inspect private fields, inject hostile copying/equality implementations, change exception rules or broaden the supported numeric domain. Return the complete corrected independent test file, not a fragment.

Main-approved. Exactly one bounded test-only correction from R19; preserve specification, reference and known-bad bytes unchanged. Preserve all valid existing R19 behavioral tests. Replace Debug substring assertions with public trait qualification: instantiate a generic bound requiring std::fmt::Debug + Clone + PartialEq + Eq separately for Observation, ModelError and ObservationStore. Merely using assert_eq does not require Eq; the generic bound must actually be instantiated for every exported type. Do not assert any Debug text, private layout, map representation, ordering policy, Default or additional traits. Retain populated-store clone equality and independent updates in both directions, atomic failed-update rollback, model-existence checks even with empty queries, empty-update no-creation, exact complete-vector matching, i128 sum boundary and truncation-toward-zero controls. Retain the existing mixed nonempty query-arity fallback and order witness; additionally make the approved tiny case explicit: two two-feature observations with outcomes 10 and 20, queried by a nonempty one-feature vector, return 15. Nonempty different query arity is valid; empty query vectors remain errors. Return the complete corrected independent test file, not a fragment.
